editModal.placeholderHint: "(No Artist)" holds the songs that have no artist, and cannot be renamed.

delete.confirmSingle: Are you sure you want to delete the artist "{{name}}" and all of its albums? This action cannot be undone.
delete.confirmPlural: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} artists and all of their albums? This action cannot be undone.
delete.songsWarningSingle_one: {{count}} song still references this artist. The artist will be removed from it, and if it is in one of the artist's albums it will be moved to "(No Album)".
delete.songsWarningSingle_other: {{count}} songs still reference this artist. The artist will be removed from them, and those in the artist's albums will be moved to "(No Album)".
delete.songsWarningPlural_one: {{count}} song still references these artists. They will be removed from it, and if it is in one of their albums it will be moved to "(No Album)".
delete.songsWarningPlural_other: {{count}} songs still reference these artists. They will be removed from them, and those in their albums will be moved to "(No Album)".

merge.title: Merge {{count}} Artists
merge.instructions: Choose the artist to keep. It takes the place of the other artists in their songs and gets their albums, and those artists are deleted.
merge.summary_one: {{count}} song will be updated to reference "{{name}}".
merge.summary_other: {{count}} songs will be updated to reference "{{name}}".
merge.mergedAlbums_one: {{count}} album has the same name as another one, and will be merged into it.
merge.mergedAlbums_other: {{count}} albums have the same name as another one, and will be merged into it.
merge.deleted_one: The other artist will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
merge.deleted_other: The other {{count}} artists will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
merge.previewFailed: Failed to check what merging the artists would change
